subtitle: Slingshot mini golf, pinball
description:
Pull back, aim, and let it fly. Bank Shot is slingshot mini golf with a pinball heart.

Each level gives you 15 seconds and 6 shots to sink the ball. Bank it off the walls, ride the bumpers, thread the fork gates, and roll over multiplier squares to stack your score. Later levels bring repelling bumpers that push your shot off line, so every bank has to be planned.

100 hand-tuned levels that get trickier as you climb. Beaten levels stay unlocked, so you can go back any time and chase a better score.

Three looks to play in: Neon, Golf and Paper.

One-thumb controls. Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: 100 levels of slingshot mini golf: bank it, bump it, sink it in 15 seconds.
reviewNote: Tap Play, then drag back from the ball and release to shoot. Sink the ball in the hole within 15 seconds and 6 shots to clear the level. Tap the Level button to pick any unlocked level and the theme button to switch looks. No account needed.
